items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Bapt said, give us a solo. And we just taking one, him and I, and from then on we just continued doing it.

ctx.x: Did you all work them out together or just get together in the spur of the moment?

I just started up one spur of the moment, just like you said. Started up one time, we was playing a one o'clock jump in the brass band. So, guys was taking solos, different ones. So, Bapt said, give us a solo. And we just taking one, him and I, and from then on we just continued doing it. Different numbers we play, we do it.
I heard him and Edgar do it about 10 years ago, too.
